text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Provisional: fitted to past weather on a screening run. Arm A1's frozen fit at 1 July 2025 (convex model, pinned capacity, drift) and arm A3's Kalman filter over the scored year. Every value is in points of the substation's effective capacity. The capacities are not measurements: the pinned one is a real-time estimate and the fitted one depends on the other terms.'
text.tspan: Provisional: fitted to past weather on a screening run. Arm A1's frozen fit at 1 July 2025
(convex model, pinned capacity, drift) and arm A3's Kalman filter over the scored year. Every
value is in points of the substation's effective capacity. The capacities are not measurements:
the pinned one is a real-time estimate and the fitted one depends on the other terms.
